display_title: The House Where the Swallow Lives

titles_en.title: The House Where the Swallow Lives

description:
Seong-hoon, who entered into a contract marriage with the 23-year-older Soo-yeon for money, was unaware that she and her entire family would die overnight. Four survivors remain in the shattered family, and as the inheritance dispute begins, another wealthy woman, Jia, approaches Seong-hoon.

Desperate to escape Soo-yeon's family and start anew with Jia, Seong-hoon makes a bold decision:
"I'm going to pretend to be the son of this house. If I marry Ryu Jia, I'll give up my claim to the inheritance."

Unable to reveal that he's a widower and facing the desperate attempts of his in-laws to keep him from getting a dime, the farcical act of a dysfunctional family begins!
